title: Development of Clinical Database of Individuals With Smith-Magenis Syndrome and Sleep Disturbances
official: Development of Clinical Database of Individuals With Smith-Magenis Syndrome
summary: This database will be used to better understand the sleep problems of people with SMS. This clinical database will be a part of a larger Smith-Magenis Patient Registry used to create an awareness campaign around SMS and the sleep disturbances that are characteristic of the disorder.

interventions.name: Data collection of sleep disturbances in individuals with SMS

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Parent or legal guardian of individual with Smith-Magenis Syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not legal guardian of individual with SMS
